title: Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Treasury Rule on the Depth of a Replenishment Shortfall
content:
**Clause.** The amount a replenishment debit on a Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service restores depends on how deep the shortfall is and on the service's recent payouts: for a ledger balance below half the alert level at a service whose payouts in the month ending today, a month that takes in every payout dated fewer than one whole month before today, whole months between two dates being the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's, came to no more than 2 times the alert level, it is the alert level plus the tier's smallest automatic replenishment debit less the balance; for a ledger balance below half the alert level at a service whose payouts in that month came to more than 2 times the alert level, it is the alert level plus that month's payout total divided by 4, less the balance; for any other balance it is the alert level less the balance.

The ledger balance is the prefund balance the ledger shows, that is every deposit, returned payout, recall and fee credit less every returned deposit, payout, fee and withdrawal on the service; the alert level is the alert level on file for the service; the month's payouts are the total of the service's payouts dated in that month.

| Ledger balance | Month's payouts | Amount restored |
|---|---|---|
| below half the alert level | no more than 2 times the alert level | the alert level plus the smallest automatic replenishment debit, less the balance |
| below half the alert level | more than 2 times the alert level | the alert level plus the month's payout total divided by 4, less the balance |
| half the alert level or more | any | the alert level less the balance |

| Tier | Smallest automatic replenishment debit (USD) |
|---|---|
| Paystride Instant Pay Starter | 0.00 (automatic replenishment not permitted) |
| Paystride Instant Pay Core | 500.00 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Growth | 1000.00 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Pro | 2500.00 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Scale | 10000.00 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Enterprise | 25000.00 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical: alert level 3000.00, so half is 1500.00 and 2 times is 6000.00; smallest debit 700.00)

- Balance 1400.00, month's payouts 5200.00: 3000.00 plus 700.00 less 1400.00 is 2300.00.
- Balance 1400.00, month's payouts exactly 6000.00: no more than 2 times, so again 2300.00.
- Balance 1400.00, month's payouts 8000.00: 3000.00 plus 2000.00 less 1400.00 is 3600.00.
- Balance 1500.00: not below half, so 3000.00 less 1500.00 is 1500.00.
